beats.summary: Michael accidentally hits Meredith with his car in the parking lot, causing her to be hospitalized with a pelvic fracture.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Ladies and Gentlemen. I have some bad news. Meredith was hit by a car.
Michael: It happened this morning in the parking lot. I took her to the hospital, and the doctors tried to save her life.

beats.summary: Michael feels guilty and others react to the accident, with Dwight suspicious about the circumstances.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Yeah, it's only Meredith, thank God. But did you see the way they looked at me? Like I was a murderer or something.
Dwight: Check to see if she's faking. If a car hit me, it wouldn't crack my pelvis.

beats.summary: Jim and Pam are rebuilding their friendship after Jim's breakup with Karen.

evidence.snippet: Pam: Jim and I went to dinner a few times when he got back from New York. I talked him through his break up.

beats.summary: Angela asks Dwight to care for her sick cat Sprinkles while she visits Meredith.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Can you do me a little favor? Go to my place at lunch and give Sprinkles her medicine.
Angela: There's a diabetes shot, roll the insulin in your hand, don't shake it.

beats.summary: Michael reflects on his life and work, mentioning Jan, Jim, Ryan, Andy, and Dwight.

evidence.snippet: Michael: This is going to be a very good year. Very good. Jan is at home. Jim is back. My protege Ryan is at corporate.
